title: Tourist Season, 2014
logline: Back from Seattle a week: the seawall, phones up at the bay, and a tourist asking if this is the town from the strip. Which strip, Wood says. The old dog under the bench doesn't get up for any of it.

panels.composition: The seawall in August, tourists with phones held up at the bay, WOOD on the bench, old BARNABY beneath it.

image.prompt: a seawall in August with tourists holding phones up at a bay and a man on a bench with an old dog beneath it, black ink

panels.composition: A tourist turning from the bay to WOOD.

balloons.text: Is this the town from the strip?

image.prompt: a tourist turning from a bay view to speak to a man on a seawall bench, black ink
a thin man on a bench answering flatly, black ink

panels.composition: The tourist gone back to the phone; the dog asleep; the bay gray; on the phone's screen, blue.

image.prompt: a tourist holding a phone up at a gray bay that shows blue on the screen, a man on a bench and an old dog asleep beneath it, black ink with one spot tone

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays
